The '''Cold Big Bang''' hypothesis is an attempt to explain the origin of the [[Universe]].

== The early Universe according to Cold Big Bang ==

<!-- illustration draft -->
Beginning of the Cold Big Bang hypothesis:
Early Universe of a gas of [[nucleon]]s and [[electron]]s of tremendous density
- Universe expands > 
density fall below critical value
- nuclear reactions>
nuclei form ('''Nuclear synthesis''')
- Universe continues to expand >
Only the lightest nuclei had time to form in significant amount:
Universe is a gas of light nuclei and electrons
- Universe continues to expand >
matter density falls further, atoms form from electromagnetic interactions between nuclei and electrons ('''Recombination''')
-  >
Small inhomogeneity
- Gravitational interactions >
Accumulation of inhomogeneity into stars, then entire galaxies

<!-- end illustration draft -->
